mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the GDP growth condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a reduction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals increased demand, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% annually, the real interest rate is high, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the RSAFS growth condition is met.
